methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this new framework, methodology, and sensitivity analysis can be used for commercial hybrid building

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a sensitivity-analysis framework/methodology (sensitivity auditing + Scaled Morris Method) built on a Python-EnergyPlus-Abaqus multi-physics simulation platform for commercial building energy-structure design. No EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement or baseline model is identified or characterised, and there is no ISO 50001/50006 energy-management context; the reported 'performance indicators' are simulation outputs (yearly/peak cooling/heating load) used for design-factor sensitivity ranking.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A new systematic methodology of sensitivity analysis considering sensitivity auditing and a scaled Morris Method is proposed within the context of hybrid building energy-structure performance

stage1.notes: Commercial-building (curtain-wall & precast-concrete-panel, 50-story) energy-structure sensitivity study via >2000 EnergyPlus/Abaqus simulations over 4 climate zones. Not an EnPI/EnB measurement model; eligibility (false) is a Tier-1 judgment call (~0.8). paper_type methodological/theoretical vs tool/software design is a secondary judgment call.
